newsitem.title: USA: Tecumseh completes acquisitions in India.
newsitem.headline: Tecumseh completes acquisitions in India.

text.p: Tecumseh Products Co said Monday it completed two previously announced pending acquisitions in India for a purchase price of about $45 million.

Tecumseh finalized the acquisition of refrigeration compressor manufacturing facilities from Whirlpool of India Ltd in the state of Haryana and acquired 100 percent of Siel Compressors Ltd of Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India. In April Tecumseh acquired 50 percent of Siel Compressors.
Siel Compressors is a subsidiary of Siel Ltd.
The formerly owned Whirlpool facilities in Haryana will make refrigeration compressors, and Tecumseh said it expects to expand capacity over the next several years.

Siel Compressors, a former licensee of Tecumseh, will continue to manufacture air conditioning compressors. Once expanded and fully equipped, these combined operations will be able to produce two to three million compressors annually.
The acquisitions will be accounted for using the purchase accounting method.
Whirlpool of India is a majority-owned subsidiary of Whirlpool Corp. Siel Compressors makes compressors for the Indian air conditioning industry.
